title: Automatic Translation of Hate Speech to Non-hate Speech in Social Media Texts

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the performance of text-to-text machine translation models (RNN, T5, mBART, Marian) in rewriting hateful Spanish social media texts into non-hateful equivalents while preserving meaning, evaluated using BLEU scores.
Evaluating the detoxification of misogynistic and sexist language by leveraging a Spanish hate speech dataset originally from the IberEval 2018 Automatic Misogyny Identification task.
Qualitatively analyzing the translation models' generated outputs when provided with input texts containing homophobic slurs (e.g., 'marica') to assess the removal of biased sentiment.
